$comment: Deliberate deviations from the Figma export. Each entry keeps the shipped app looking the same until the design file is aligned. Delete an entry to let Figma win; the generator prints every override it applies.

lineHeight.$reason: Figma uses AUTO line height, which has no numeric value. These are the values the app ships with today.

letterSpacing.$reason: The app renders without letter spacing. Applying Figma values changes every text on every screen; needs owner sign-off.

fontSize.$reason: Figma strikethrough is 16, the app ships 14 (used for crossed-out prices next to 14px body text).

textDecorationLine.$reason: The export does not carry text decoration yet.
